description: Defines the rx::Image9 class, which provides an interface to underlying Direct3D 9 surfaces of a Texture, including methods for surface management, data loading, copying, and mipmap generation.

classes.name: Image9
classes.description: Interface to Direct3D 9 surfaces of a Texture, managing surface creation, data loading, copying, and mipmap generation.

methods.name: Image9
methods.description: Constructor for Image9, initializes with a Renderer9 reference.

methods.name: GenerateMip
methods.description: Generates a mipmap level from a source surface.

methods.name: redefine
methods.description: Redefines the texture with new type, format, and size.

methods.name: getD3DFormat
methods.description: Returns the D3D format of the surface.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the surface is dirty.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies surface data to texture storage.

methods.name: loadCompressedData
methods.description: Loads compressed data into the surface.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the surface for direct access.

methods.name: copyFromRTInternal
methods.description: Copies from a render target internally.
